propositions: An optional, isolated adapter must extract and deterministically classify error signatures from Claude Code session transcripts using pattern matching (no LLM calls), emitting records labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified.

The transcript adapter module must define a classification enum with exactly five values (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) and apply error-signature routing rules (ModuleNotFoundError→env_setup, pip errors→dependency, ConnectionError→integration, git/ruff errors→tooling) using case-insensitive substring/regex matching.
Core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the claude_transcripts adapter, enforcing that the optional backfill adapter is quarantined and does not pollute the portable command.

Unit tests must verify that fixture JSONL transcripts with known error signatures are extracted and classified with correct kind and source/confidence labels, and that clean transcripts yield no output, all without network or LLM calls.
The backfill_transcripts.py script entry point must be exercised end-to-end over a fixture transcript directory, emitting the expected labeled classified records.
